subject: Re: Kickoff: state-similarity service - April status
body:
Status update.

Track A done: compute_metric reproduces the paper numbers on the mirrored_rooms grid (we run with --nosample_distance_pairs, matching the paper setup). Carmen also validated a programmatically constructed 40x40 square grid, so the exact path scales further than we promised.

Track B: Tereza got the trained Rainbow checkpoints loading cleanly, and the on-policy approximant trains on the state representations. The risk: approximant quality degrades noticeably when we subsample fewer than ~10M state pairs per game - our current estimate says the June sweep at 256 accelerators covers 20 games at full pair counts, not the 40 we pitched. Trade-off is fewer games vs. noisier metrics.

Proposal: cut to 20 games for the June sweep, keep full pair sampling. Need a decision by May 8 to lock the sweep configs.

Efe
